page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr6.20xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 80 dedicated physical cores with an x86_64 architecture, utilizing the Intel Xeon 8269CY processor operating at a clock speed of 3.1 GHz. A key architectural characteristic is the 1.0 thread-per-core configuration, meaning hyperthreading is disabled, providing dedicated physical execution resources for each vCPU.

The instance is equipped with 768.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high resource density of 9.6 GB of RAM per core. It does not include any local storage, requiring external block storage volumes for operating system and data persistence. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 25 Gbps. There are no integrated GPUs on this instance type.

Given the high memory-to-CPU ratio and dedicated physical cores, this instance type offers high resource density for memory-bound applications. The absence of hyperthreading ensures predictable compute performance, though it limits concurrent thread execution compared to hyperthreaded alternatives. This hardware profile is suited for large-scale in-memory databases, enterprise resource planning systems, memory-intensive data processing pipelines, and large-scale caching layers.
